g.text: E / READING THE TWO STREAMS

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #182b43

g.text: M carries depth history; MHA supplies token-to-token communication

text.style: font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #087f83

g.text: L layer: M(t) → Q/K, V and O at token t; injected V is then transported by ordinary MHA.

text.style: font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #087f83

g.text: F layer: the existing MHA map transports S(s) to t; a query-conditioned read converts the fetched matrix into O.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52647a

g.text: Both: fused O(t) supplies write data, while x(t) supplies the address and write gate; the FFN updates only the residual stream.
